name: skLEP
description: skLEP is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Slovak natural language understanding models, covering nine diverse tasks at token, sentence-pair, and document levels. It includes newly curated Slovak datasets and translated English NLU resources, along with an open-source toolkit and public leaderboard.
reputation: First systematic evaluation of Slovak-specific and multilingual models; publicly released with toolkit and leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on Slovak language understanding with a variety of task types and levels.
